choice.title: Unsubscribe from SolidPing alerts
choice.intro: You are unsubscribing {email} from incident alert emails.
choice.wholeOrg: Unsubscribe from all alert emails for this organization
choice.undoHint: You can undo this at any time from the confirmation page shown after you unsubscribe, as long as this link hasn't expired.

success.title: Unsubscribed
success.org: {email} will no longer receive all alert emails for this organization.
success.check: {email} will no longer receive alerts for {check}.
success.thisCheck: {email} will no longer receive alerts for this check.
success.othersUnaffected: Other recipients of these alerts are not affected.

resubscribed.title: Re-subscribed
resubscribed.body: You will receive alert emails again for this scope.

missing.title: Missing token
missing.heading: Missing link parameters
missing.body: This URL is missing required parameters. Please use the full link from the original email.

invalid.title: Invalid or expired link
invalid.heading: This link is invalid or has expired
invalid.body: The unsubscribe link could not be verified, or it has expired. If you have a more recent alert email, try the link from that message instead.

orgNotFound.title: Organization not found
orgNotFound.body: The organization this link refers to no longer exists.

success.title: Incident acknowledged
success.thanks: Thanks, the incident has been acknowledged.

expired.title: Link expired
expired.heading: This link has expired
expired.body_one: Magic-link ack tokens are valid for {count} day. Open the dashboard to acknowledge this incident manually.
expired.body_other: Magic-link ack tokens are valid for {count} days. Open the dashboard to acknowledge this incident manually.

invalid.title: Invalid link
invalid.heading: This link is invalid
invalid.body: The acknowledgment link could not be verified. If you have a valid email notification, try the link from that message, or open the dashboard to acknowledge manually.

missingToken.title: Missing token
missingToken.body: This URL is missing the token query parameter. Please use the full link from the original email.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't acknowledge the incident. Please try again, or open the dashboard to acknowledge manually.
